Wood Mod Packager

Bundle a Lua mod, optional PNG icon, and mod details into one .tungmod file that Wood loads from the game’s Mods folder.

9.0 MBPNG up to 2048×2048No Python install needed
Download Mod Packager ↓

Unsigned executable. SHA-256: 5b2fd8398568fd7edbada56d51734f62563f2437a50cce564467d260aa8e88f0

Build and install a mod package

  1. Run WoodModPackager.exe and choose your mod’s .lua source.
  2. Enter a unique mod ID, name, version, author, and description. Add a PNG icon if wanted, then choose where to save the package.
  3. Click Build .tungmod. The tool creates one package containing the Lua, metadata, and optional icon.
  4. Copy the resulting .tungmod into TUNG’s Mods folder and restart TUNG. The F10 mod list displays its PNG icon when the image can be loaded.

Install Wood

  1. Download and run Wood Setup. Choose the TUNG folder when prompted.
  2. Run TUNG through Steam and press F10 to open Wood’s mod menu.

To verify downloaded executables, compare their displayed SHA-256 with SHA256SUMS.txt.

Compatibility

Windows x64 and the current Steam installation of TUNG. Game updates can require a Wood runtime update.
